discrepancies.pems_original: Brief guidance on identifying patients for potential direct transport to a mental health facility.
discrepancies.converted_text: Includes significant additional procedural detail regarding Psychiatric vs Medical ECOs, law enforcement custody, and restraint-specific transport instructions not found in the original PEMS protocol for this topic.
discrepancies.recommendation: Review if the added ECO/Law Enforcement material should be in a separate, dedicated policy/protocol or if it belongs here. If it is PEMS-compliant, it needs to be clearly marked as such or derived from other PEMS policies (e.g. Patient Restraint/Refusal).
